source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 17 (PDF 73-82), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Human Reproductive System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which function belongs to the female reproductive system but not the male?
(Kaun sa kaam female reproductive system ka hai, male ka nahi?)

options.text: Fertilized egg ko ghiza dena aur nashonuma ka mahol dena
Gametes ko fertilization ke liye tayyar karna

blocks.explanation: Dono nizam gametes banate aur tayyar karte hain; male gametes pohanchata hai, female fertilized egg ko ghiza aur nashonuma ka mahol deta hai.

book_ref.quote: the female reproductive system nourishes the fertilized egg cell

blocks.prompt:
2 Unlike other body systems, the reproductive system becomes functional:
(Doosre nizamon ke bar-aks reproductive system kab kaam shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre nizam paidaish se ya foran baad kaam karte hain; reproductive system sirf puberty (baloghat) par kaam shuru karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reproductive system does not become functional until at puberty

blocks.prompt:
3 The testes are located in a skin pouch called the:
(Testes jild ki kis theli mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do testes pait se bahar jild ki theli scrotum mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Two testes are located outside the abdomen in a skin pouch called scrotum

blocks.prompt:
4 Each human testis measures about:
(Har insani testis ka size taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har bayzavi testis taqreeban 3–5 cm lamba aur 2–3 cm chora hai.

book_ref.quote: measures about 3–5 cm in length and 2–3 cm in width

blocks.prompt:
5 In the germinal epithelium, the developing sperms are nourished by:
(Germinal epithelium mein banne wale sperms ko kaun ghiza deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Germinal epithelium mein germline cells (meiosis se sperm banate) aur Sertoli cells (banne wale sperms ko ghiza dete) hain.

book_ref.quote: Sertoli cell nourish the developing sperms

blocks.prompt:
6 The scrotum keeps the testes at a temperature of about:
(Scrotum testes ko taqreeban kis darja-e-hararat par rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scrotum testes ko taqreeban 34°C par rakhta hai, jo jism ke andaruni darje (37°C) se thora kam hai; sperm ki nashonuma ke liye zaroori.

book_ref.quote: The scrotum maintains the testes at around 34°C

blocks.prompt:
7 During development the testes form within the abdominal cavity and descend into the scrotum:
(Nashonuma mein testes pait mein bante hain aur scrotum mein kab utarte hain?)

options.text: taqreeban 10 se 14 saal ki umar mein

blocks.explanation: Testes pait ke khane mein bante aur paidaish se kuch pehle scrotum mein utar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Shortly before birth, they descend through an opening into the scrotum

blocks.prompt:
8 From the seminiferous tubules, spermatozoa first enter a network of tubules called the:
(Seminiferous tubules se sperms pehle naliyon ke kis jaal mein jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Seminiferous tubules se sperms rete testis aur phir epididymis mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: the spermatozoa enter into a network of tubules called rete testis

blocks.prompt:
9 Spermatozoa remain in the epididymis for at least:
(Sperms epididymis mein kam az kam kitni der rehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Epididymis mein aate waqt sperms harkat nahi karte; wahan kam az kam 18 ghante reh kar harkat ke qabil hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They remain in epididymis for at least 18 hours

blocks.prompt:
10 The vas deferens passes into the abdominal cavity through the:
(Vas deferens pait ke khane mein kis raaste jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vas deferens inguinal canal ke zariye pait ke khane mein jati hai.

book_ref.quote: passes into the abdominal cavity via the inguinal canal

blocks.prompt:
11 The tube formed by the joining of the vas deferens and the duct of a seminal vesicle is the:
(Vas deferens aur seminal vesicle ki nali mil kar jo nali banati hain woh kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Seminal vesicle ki nali se milne ke baad yeh ejaculatory duct kehlati hai; dono ejaculatory ducts prostate se guzar kar urethra mein khulti hain.

book_ref.quote: After joining, the tube is called the ejaculatory duct

blocks.prompt:
12 The soft and spongy male accessory gland lying just below the urinary bladder is the:
(Urinary bladder ke bilkul neeche naram aur spongy male accessory gland kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prostate gland urinary bladder ke bilkul neeche hai aur naram aur spongy hai.

book_ref.quote: The prostate gland lies just below the urinary bladder

blocks.prompt:
13 Semen is a mixture of sperms and fluids from the:
(Semen sperms aur kin ki ratoobat ka mixture hai?)
blocks.explanation: Semen sperms aur seminal vesicles aur prostate gland ki ratoobat ka mixture hai.

book_ref.quote: Semen is a mixture of sperms and fluids from the seminal vesicles and the prostate gland

blocks.prompt:
14 The clear fluid that lubricates the urethra and provides a protective neutral environment for sperms comes from the:
(Saaf ratoobat jo urethra ko chikna kar ke sperms ko mehfooz neutral mahol deti hai, kahan se aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do chhote bulbourethral glands saaf ratoobat nikalte hain jo urethra ko chikna aur mahol neutral karti hai.

book_ref.quote: provides a protective neutral environment for sperms to survive

blocks.prompt:
15 The male copulatory organ (penis) contains:
(Male copulatory organ (penis) mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: urethra, erectile tissue, aik artery aur do veins

blocks.explanation: Penis mein urethra, erectile tissue, aik artery aur do veins hain.

book_ref.quote: It contains urethra, erectile tissue, an artery and two veins

blocks.prompt:
16 In the walls of the seminiferous tubules, germline cells (2n) divide by mitosis to form:
(Seminiferous tubules ki deewar mein germline cells (2n) mitosis se kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Germline cells mitosis se taqseem hote hain; kuch spermatogonia (2n) bante, kuch aainda ke liye germline cells rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some of the new cells become spermatogonia (2n)

blocks.prompt:
17 Primary spermatocytes are:
(Primary spermatocytes kaise hote hain?)

options.text: diploid (2n) aur tubules ke lumen ki taraf jate hain
haploid aur seedhe sperm ban jate hain
diploid aur epididymis mein rehte hain

blocks.explanation: Spermatogonia primary spermatocytes (2n) banate hain jo lumen ki taraf ja kar meiosis-I se taqseem hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Primary spermatocytes move toward the inner space (lumen) of the tubules

blocks.prompt:
18 One spermatogonium (2n) finally produces:
(Aik spermatogonium (2n) aakhir mein kitne spermatids banata hai?)

options.text: aik spermatid aur teen polar bodies

blocks.explanation: Primary spermatocyte → 2 secondary spermatocytes (meiosis-I) → 4 spermatids (meiosis-II).

book_ref.quote: one spermatogonium (2n) produces four spermatids (1n)

blocks.prompt:
19 The thick cap surrounding about two-thirds of the sperm head is the:
(Sperm ke sar ke taqreeban do tihai hisse ko gherne wali moti topi kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acrosome sar ke do tihai hisse ko dhakta hai; yeh zyada tar Golgi body se banta aur fertilization ke enzymes rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: About two-thirds of the head is surrounded by a thick cap called the acrosome

blocks.prompt:
20 The acrosome of a sperm is formed mainly from the:
(Sperm ka acrosome zyada tar kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acrosome zyada tar Golgi body se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The acrosome is formed mainly of Golgi Body

blocks.prompt:
21 The midpiece of a sperm contains:
(Sperm ke midpiece mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Midpiece mein mitochondria aur aik centriole hain; genetic maddah sar mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The midpiece contains mitochondria and a centriole

blocks.prompt:
22 The tail of a sperm is formed of microtubules (axial filament) arising from the:
(Sperm ki dum microtubules (axial filament) se bani hai jo kahan se nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dum ke microtubules (axial filament) midpiece ke centriole se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The tail is formed of microtubules (axial filament)

blocks.prompt:
23 Non-motile spermatozoa move from the lumen of seminiferous tubules into the epididymis with the help of:
(Harkat na karne wale sperms seminiferous tubules se epididymis tak kis ki madad se jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lumen ke sperms harkat nahi karte; Sertoli cells ki ratoobat inhein epididymis le jati hai jahan woh harkat ke qabil hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They enter the epididymis with the help of the fluid secreted by Sertoli cells

blocks.prompt:
24 The hormone released by the hypothalamus that stimulates the anterior pituitary to release FSH and LH is:
(Hypothalamus ka woh hormone jo anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH nikalwata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus GnRH nikalta hai jo anterior pituitary ko FSH aur LH nikalne par uksata hai.

book_ref.quote: The hypothalamus releases gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH)

blocks.prompt:
25 Leydig cells are located in the:
(Leydig cells kahan hote hain?)

options.text: seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan interstitial tissue

blocks.explanation: LH Leydig cells ko uksata hai jo seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan interstitial tissue mein hain.

book_ref.quote: located in the interstitial tissue between the seminiferous tubules

blocks.prompt:
26 Inhibin, which inhibits further FSH secretion, is released by:
(Inhibin jo mazeed FSH ko rokta hai, kaun nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: FSH Sertoli cells se peptide hormone inhibin nikalwata hai jo mazeed FSH rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: it causes the Sertoli cells to release a peptide hormone called inhibin

blocks.prompt:
27 A rise in testosterone level inhibits the release of:
(Testosterone ka barhna kis ke nikalne ko rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Testosterone (LH ke asar se) LH aur GnRH ko rokta hai: negative feedback.

book_ref.quote: the release of testosterone inhibits the release of LH and GnRH

blocks.prompt:
28 Which is a function of testosterone?
(Testosterone ka kaam kaun sa hai?)

options.text: Mardana secondary jinsi khasoosiyat qaim rakhna

blocks.explanation: Testosterone germinal epithelium ki nashonuma karta aur mardana sanwi (secondary) jinsi khasoosiyat qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Testosterone stimulates the development of germinal epithelium

blocks.prompt:
29 The accessory organs of the female reproductive system are:
(Female reproductive system ke accessory organs kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Female nizam mein gonads, oviducts, uterus aur vagina hain; aakhri teen accessory organs hain.

book_ref.quote: The oviducts, uterus and vagina are called accessory organs

blocks.prompt:
30 The functional units of the ovary are the:
(Ovary ki kaam ki ikaai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ovary mein bohat se chhote theli numa ovarian follicles hain jo is ki kaam ki ikaai hain aur kachchay ande paalte hain.

book_ref.quote: ovarian follicles which are the functional units of ovary

blocks.prompt:
31 After ovulation, the ruptured follicle is transformed into the:
(Ovulation ke baad phata hua follicle kis mein badal jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ovulation ke baad phata follicle glandular banawat corpus luteum ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the ruptured follicle is transformed into a glandular structure called the corpus luteum

blocks.prompt:
32 The ovum travels along the oviduct toward the uterus with the help of:
(Ovum oviduct mein uterus ki taraf kis ki madad se chalta hai?)

options.text: oviduct ki andaruni teh ke cilia

blocks.explanation: Ovum ki uterus ki taraf harkat oviduct ki andaruni teh ke cilia se aasan hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This movement is facilitated by the movements of cilia on the inner lining of oviduct

blocks.prompt:
33 The zygote begins several mitotic divisions while it is still in the:
(Zygote kai mitotic taqseemein kahan shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fertilization oviduct mein hoti hai aur zygote wahin kai mitotic taqseemein karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The resulting zygote undergoes several mitotic divisions while still in oviduct

blocks.prompt:
34 The uppermost rounded part of the uterus above the openings of the oviducts is the:
(Uterus ka sab se upar gol hissa jo oviducts ke munh ke upar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ke teen hisse: fundus (sab se upar), body (bara hissa) aur cervix (nichla tang hissa).

book_ref.quote: Fundus is the uppermost rounded portion above the openings of oviducts

blocks.prompt:
35 The lower narrow part of the uterus that opens into the vagina is the:
(Uterus ka nichla tang hissa jo vagina mein khulta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ka nichla tang hissa cervix hai; is ka munh vagina mein khulta hai.

book_ref.quote: The lower narrow part of uterus is called cervix

blocks.prompt:
36 The middle thick layer of the uterine wall, made of smooth muscles, is the:
(Uterus ki deewar ki darmiyani moti teh jo smooth muscles se bani hai:)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ki deewar: perimetrium (bahar patli), myometrium (darmiyani moti smooth muscle), endometrium (andar spongy teh).

book_ref.quote: The myometrium is the middle thick layer composed of smooth muscles

blocks.prompt:
37 The functional layer of the endometrium is regenerated by stem cells of the:
(Endometrium ki functional teh kis ke stem cells se dobara banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Endometrium ki basal teh ke stem cells functional teh dobara banate hain jo har cycle mein utar jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The basal layer has the stems cells which regenerate the functional layer

blocks.prompt:
38 During pregnancy, the vascular spaces of the functional layer of the endometrium fuse to form the:
(Hamal mein endometrium ki functional teh ke vascular khane mil kar kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Functional teh mazeed moti hoti; is ke vascular khane mil kar placenta banate hain jo embryo aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.

book_ref.quote: forming the placenta, which supplies oxygen and nutrition to the embryo and foetus

blocks.prompt:
39 The vagina is a thin-walled tube about:
(Vagina patli deewar wali nali hai, taqreeban kitni lambi?)
blocks.explanation: Vagina 8-10 cm lambi patli nali hai jo bahar se cervix tak hai; yeh wiladat aur haiz ke bahao ka raasta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a thin-walled 8-10 cm long tube

blocks.prompt:
40 During embryonic development of a female, primary oocytes begin meiosis-I but stop in:
(Female ki janeeni nashonuma mein primary oocytes meiosis-I shuru kar ke kahan ruk jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oogonia (2n) mitosis se primary oocytes (2n) banate hain jo meiosis-I shuru kar ke bachpan bhar prophase-I mein ruke rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: These primary oocytes begin the first meiotic division, but stop in prophase-I

blocks.prompt:
41 The secondary oocyte stops its division at:
(Secondary oocyte apni taqseem kahan rok deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Puberty par meiosis-I ke baad secondary oocyte metaphase-II mein ruk jata hai jab tak sperm us se na mile.

book_ref.quote: The secondary oocyte stops division in metaphase-II

blocks.prompt:
42 Meiosis-I of a primary oocyte produces:
(Primary oocyte ki meiosis-I se kya banta hai?)

options.text: aik ovum aur second polar body
aik bara secondary oocyte aur chhota first polar body

blocks.explanation: Meiosis-I do na-barabar haploid cells deti hai: bara secondary oocyte (1n) aur chhota first polar body (1n).

book_ref.quote: The larger cell is the secondary oocyte (1n) while smaller one is called the first polar body (1n)

blocks.prompt:
43 When a sperm fuses with the secondary oocyte, meiosis-II is completed and produces:
(Sperm ke secondary oocyte se milne par meiosis-II mukammal ho kar kya banata hai?)

options.text: aik bara ovum aur chhota second polar body

blocks.explanation: Sperm se milne par secondary oocyte oviduct mein jaldi meiosis-II mukammal kar ke aik bara ovum (1n) aur chhota second polar body (1n) banata hai.

book_ref.quote: It produces two new cells i.e., one large ovum (1n) and a small second polar body (1n)

blocks.prompt:
44 If an ovulated secondary oocyte is not fertilized by a sperm, it:
(Agar ovulate shuda secondary oocyte sperm se fertilize na ho to kya hota hai?)

options.text: dobara primary oocyte ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jo ovulate shuda secondary oocyte fertilize na ho woh mar jata hai.

book_ref.quote: If an ovulated secondary oocyte is not fertilized by a sperm, it dies

blocks.prompt:
45 At birth, a female's ovaries contain about:
(Paidaish par larki ki ovaries mein taqreeban kitne follicles hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paidaish par ovaries mein taqreeban 2 million follicles hote hain, har aik mein aik primary oocyte.

book_ref.quote: At birth, a female’s ovaries contain some 2 million follicles

blocks.text: Female Reproductive Cycle - The Menstrual Cycle

blocks.prompt:
46 On average, the menstrual cycle lasts:
(Menstrual cycle ausatan kitne din ka hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Menstrual cycle taqreeban aik mahina, ausatan 28 din, ka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The menstrual cycle lasts approximately one month (28 days on average)

blocks.prompt:
47 Menstruation (shedding of the functional layer of endometrium) occurs due to:
(Menstruation (endometrium ki functional teh ka utarna) kis wajah se hota hai?)

options.text: estrogen aur progesterone ki zyada miqdar
estrogen aur progesterone ki kam miqdar

blocks.explanation: Menstruation, jo 3-5 din rehta hai, estrogen aur progesterone ki kam miqdar se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It occurs due to low levels of estrogen and progesterone hormones

blocks.prompt:
48 When FSH rises at the start of the proliferative phase:
(Proliferative phase ke shuru mein FSH barhne par kya hota hai?)

options.text: tamam follicles pak kar ande chhorte hain
corpus luteum foran ban jata hai
kuch follicles barhte hain magar sirf aik poora barhta hai aur baqi khatam ho jate hain

blocks.explanation: Kuch follicles barhte hain; sirf aik poora Graafian follicle banta hai aur baqi khatam ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: But, only one follicle grows full and the others degenerate

blocks.prompt:
49 In the proliferative phase, estrogen from the Graafian follicle:
(Proliferative phase mein Graafian follicle ka estrogen kya karta hai?)

options.text: endometrium ko phir naliyon wala, makhmali aur mota karta hai
corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: Estrogen endometrium mein khoon ki naliyan shuru karta aur use phir makhmali aur mota kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It causes the initial vascularization of endometrium and makes it velvety and thick again

blocks.prompt:
50 In the proliferative phase, the level of FSH falls because of:
(Proliferative phase mein FSH ki miqdar kis wajah se ghat-ti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Estrogen barhne par negative feedback se FSH ghat jata hai.

book_ref.quote: As the concentration of estrogen rises, the level of FSH falls due to negative feedback

blocks.prompt:
51 The colour of the corpus luteum is:
(Corpus luteum ka rang kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ovulation ke baad LH phate Graafian follicle ko peeli banawat corpus luteum bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: develop into a yellow structure called the corpus luteum

blocks.prompt:
52 If fertilization does not occur, the abrupt fall in estrogen and progesterone results from:
(Fertilization na ho to estrogen aur progesterone ki achanak kami kis wajah se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam hota hai; is se estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte aur day 28 par menstruation hota hai.

book_ref.quote: the corpus luteum starts to degenerate

blocks.prompt:
53 After fertilization, the corpus luteum is maintained by:
(Fertilization ke baad corpus luteum ko kaun qaim rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota embryo hCG nikalta hai jo corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai, is liye menstruation nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: the tiny embryo secretes human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)

blocks.prompt:
54 The hormone tested for in all pregnancy tests is:
(Tamam pregnancy tests mein kaun sa hormone check kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: hCG embryo ke chorion se aata hai, maa se nahi, is liye har pregnancy test mein yahi check hota hai.

book_ref.quote: it is the hormone that is tested for in all pregnancy tests

blocks.prompt:
55 The stopping of the menstrual cycle at around 50 years of age is called:
(Taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein menstrual cycle ka ruk jana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aurton mein taqreeban 50 saal par menstrual cycle ruk jata hai; ise menopause kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: menstrual cycle stops around 50 year of age and it is termed as menopause
